title: At the vet
instructions: Ece kedisini veterinere götürüyor. Uzun bir diyalog; belirtiler, sebep ve tedaviyi takip et. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: vet
script.text: Hello. What seems to be the problem?

script.speaker: ece
script.text: It's my cat, Pamuk. She hasn't eaten anything for two days, and she sleeps all the time.

script.speaker: ece
script.text: She's seven. Last year she was ill too, but it was her stomach.

script.speaker: vet
script.text: Let me look. Hmm, I think it's her teeth. One of them is broken. That's why she can't eat.

script.speaker: vet
script.text: Not very serious, but we need to take the tooth out. We can do it tomorrow morning.

script.speaker: vet
script.text: Give her some soft food tonight, but nothing after ten o'clock.

script.speaker: ece
script.text: OK. How long will she stay here tomorrow?

script.speaker: vet
script.text: You can bring her at eight and collect her at about four in the afternoon.

script.speaker: ece
script.text: And how much will it cost?

script.speaker: vet
script.text: About one hundred and twenty pounds, with the medicine.

questions.prompt: How long hasn't the cat eaten?
questions.feedback: Kedi iki gündür (for two days) bir şey yemiyor. Yedi, kedinin yaşı.
questions.evidence: She hasn't eaten anything for two days

questions.prompt: What was the problem last year?
questions.evidence: Last year she was ill too, but it was her stomach.

questions.prompt: Why can't the cat eat now?
questions.feedback: Bir dişi kırık; bu yüzden yiyemiyor.
questions.evidence: One of them is broken. That's why she can't eat.

options: give her soft food before ten
questions.feedback: Bu akşam yumuşak yiyecek verebilir ama saat ondan sonra hiçbir şey vermemeli.
questions.evidence: Give her some soft food tonight, but nothing after ten o'clock.

questions.prompt: When can Ece collect her cat tomorrow?
options: at about four in the afternoon
questions.feedback: Sabah sekizde getirip öğleden sonra dört civarında alacak.
questions.evidence: collect her at about four in the afternoon.
